customSleeveAtlas.sourceContract: Fashion Sense 7.5.0 Default Short/Default Tall animation template
customSleeveAtlas.notes: The framework template supplies pose topology only. V5B authors target-resolution mask, cuff, seam, and material pixels directly.

SLEEVELESS.notes: The previous HideSleeves approach hid the arm layer. V5C2 converts the complete Default Short garment mask into skin-tone masks and keeps HideSleeves false.

SHORT_SLEEVE.notes: Uses the existing native Farmer sleeve animation and the shirt's three SleeveColors.

FITTED_LONG_SLEEVE.notes: Uses the complete Fashion Sense 252-frame Tall pose topology at 32x64 logical pixels and Scale 2.

LOOSE_LONG_SLEEVE.notes: Fashion Sense can draw it, but an original expanded arm silhouette must be proven in tools, sitting, and horse poses.

OVERSIZED_LONG_SLEEVE.notes: Large cuffs and dropped mass risk hand/tool occlusion and are excluded from the diagnostic batch.

PUFF_VOLUME_SLEEVE.notes: Standing geometry is feasible; full arm rotation and side-pose volume remain unproven.

OFF_SHOULDER.notes: Requires an exposed-skin coverage envelope and body compatibility tests beyond the conservative default-Farmer envelope.

ONE_SHOULDER_ASYMMETRIC.notes: Left/right flipping and tool subframes need a dedicated asymmetry contract; it is not a safe generic option yet.

ROLLED_CUFFED_SLEEVE.notes: Uses Short pose topology with a target-resolution cuff termination at the garment/skin boundary.

LAYERED_INNER_OUTER_SLEEVE.notes: One generated companion appearance carries coordinated outer cloth and inner/cuff treatment from the same semantic recipe.
